column1: # Excerpt export timing per source format (AAC .m4a output). Environment: simulator iPhone18,3, iOS 26.5 (23F77), Debug build, output at 1 % volume (quiet test runs)
# 14 excerpts per format; errors = true content position minus intended, ms (positive = later); budget 500 ms
